_meta.description: Kerala district & sessions court formatting rules — drives cause-title, party designations, prayer language, verification format
_meta.change_protocol: CLO sign-off required for any change. Vishal raises Jira tickets to Ajay for additions; never edits unilaterally.

designation: IN THE COURT OF DISTRICT & SESSIONS JUDGE
jurisdictionNote: District-level criminal and civil courts in Kerala. Sessions courts try offences punishable with imprisonment exceeding 7 years. Kerala operates under the Kerala Civil Courts Act, 1957 and the Kerala Civil Rules of Practice, 1971. Sessions cases are numbered 'S.C.', criminal calendar cases 'C.C.', criminal miscellaneous petitions 'C.M.P.'

party_designation.state: State of Kerala through the Principal Secretary, Home Department, Government of Kerala, Thiruvananthapuram

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And for this act of kindness, the petitioner shall, as in duty bound, ever pray.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby solemnly affirm and declare that the contents of the above petition from paragraph ___ to paragraph ___ are true to my personal knowledge and the contents of paragraphs ___ to ___ are believed to be true on the basis of information received and legal advice tendered, which I believe to be true. Nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Solemnly affirmed at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT
localRules: Bail applications under S.483 BNSS must disclose any earlier rejection by the Magistrate or any co-ordinate court.
Anticipatory bail applications (S.482 BNSS) must be accompanied by an affidavit and certified copy of the FIR.
Vakalatnama in the form prescribed under the Kerala Civil Rules of Practice, 1971 to be filed at first instance with requisite court-fee stamp.
All civil pleadings to be paginated, indexed and accompanied by a list of documents under Order VII / Order VIII CPC.
Malayalam translation may be insisted upon for English documents; cf. Kerala Official Language Act, 1969.
Sessions cases under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, NDPS Act and POCSO Act are tried by designated Special Courts notified by the State Government.
Ernakulam houses the Principal District Court and a dedicated Commercial Court under the Commercial Courts Act, 2015.
Service of summons supplemented by registered post AD under the Kerala Civil Rules of Practice, 1971.
e-Filing operational at Ernakulam, Thiruvananthapuram and Kozhikode District Courts; Kerala has been an early adopter of court digitisation under the High Court of Kerala's e-Courts mission.
e_filing_note: e-Filing operational at major district HQs via the eCourts portal; Kerala High Court has progressively expanded coverage.
